original_question: How much Force power can Yoda output?
short_answer_summary: The X-wing lift gives a lower bound around 19 kW, roughly 25 horsepower.
detailed_scientific_explanation: The author uses original-trilogy footage, ignoring prequels. X-wing mass is estimated by cubically scaling a 19 m, 19,700 kg F-22 to 12.5 m. Timing the front strut emerging from water gives about 1.4 m rise in 3.6 s. Wookieepedia supplies Dagobah gravity of 0.9g. Gravitational work per time gives 19.2 kW, enough for a block of homes or an electric Smart Car. Emperor lightning might resemble 10 kW pulsed Tesla-coil displays, but a sustained arc could imply megawatts. Luke's brief lightsaber retrieval is estimated at 400 W. At world electricity demand near 2 TW, about 100 million Yodas would be needed.
initial_assumptions: Geometric mass scaling with cube of length
Film timing and estimated strut length
Lower bound on demonstrated peak power, not biological energy budget

quantitative_facts.value: 5600 kg × 0.9g × 1.4 m / 3.6 s = 19.2 kW; 25 hp; source-era electricity value ~$2/hour; Luke ~400 W; 100 million Yodas for ~2 TW

uncertainties_and_limitations: X-wing mass not canonically established in source
extraction_notes: Source transcript is machine OCR and requires line-by-line proofreading against page images.
